market_summary: US and Asian markets declined on November 13 as investors reacted to Nvidia founder Jensen Huang's sudden resignation following reports of personal scandals, erasing $450 billion from the company's market value. The S&P 500 fell 0.35% to 7,592.40 and Nasdaq dropped 0.39% as geopolitical tensions over Iran, rising Treasury yields near 5.1%, and expectations of a Fed rate hike weighed on sentiment. Singapore stocks were mixed, with Singtel rallying on raised FY2027 guidance after 10% H1 underlying profit growth, while Singapore Airlines faced headwinds as record S$11.3B revenue was offset by surging fuel costs that cut H1 profit 44%. Singapore's major banks reported Q3 earnings with mixed results: OCBC beat forecasts with 3% profit growth, while DBS and UOB disappointed, pressuring valuations amid concerns over net interest margin compression.

items.headline: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO After Personal Affairs Scandal
items.summary: Nvidia's co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as President and CEO effective immediately after reports of extramarital affairs including involvement with alleged Chinese spy emerged. CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO and Harvey Jones named first board chair. Nvidia's market value fell $450 billion in preceding days.

items.headline: Singtel Raises FY2027 Guidance as H1 Underlying Profit Grows 10%
items.summary: Singtel's H1 underlying profit rose 10% to S$1.49 billion, driven by NCS, Digital InfraCo, Optus, and regional associates. Reported net profit fell 55% to S$1.54 billion as prior-year divestment gains were not repeated. Group raised full-year OpCo EBIT growth guidance to mid-to-high single digits.

items.headline: DBS Names Anthony Lim as New Chairman From January 1, 2027
items.summary: DBS announced Peter Seah will retire as chairman at end of 2026 after 16 years, with board member Anthony Lim taking over from January 1, 2027. Seah to serve as senior adviser for one year.

items.headline: DBS Q3 2026 Profit Misses Estimates, Falls 5% YoY to S$2.81B
items.summary: DBS Group's Q3 net profit declined 5% year-on-year to S$2.81 billion, missing analyst forecasts. Lower market trading income amid unfavourable equity market conditions drove the miss. Net interest margins under pressure.

items.headline: OCBC Beats Q3 2026 Forecasts With 3% YoY Profit Growth
items.summary: OCBC was the only major Singapore bank to beat Q3 2026 expectations, with net profit rising 3% year-on-year to S$2.04 billion. Nine-month net profit reached record S$6.24 billion, up 10% from prior year.

items.headline: UOB Q3 2026 Profit Misses Expectations Amid Margin Pressures
items.summary: United Overseas Bank's Q3 2026 profit came in below analyst expectations with continued net interest margin compression. Rising deposit costs and elevated funding expenses pressured earnings.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines H1 FY27 Profit Plunges 44% Despite Record S$11.3B Revenue
items.summary: Singapore Airlines reported record H1 revenue of S$11.3 billion but net profit fell 44% to S$134 million. Average jet fuel prices surged 86.7% to US$171/barrel driven by Middle East conflict, with fuel bill up 56% to S$4 billion. Passenger volumes hit 21.8 million, up 5%.

items.headline: US Markets Decline on Nvidia CEO Exit, Iran Tensions and Fed Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.35% to 7,592.40, Nasdaq dropped 0.39%, and Dow declined 0.36% on November 12. Nvidia's Jensen Huang resignation, rising Treasury yields near 5.1%, and geopolitical tensions over Iran weighed on sentiment. Markets price 85% probability of December Fed rate hike.

items.headline: US Futures Edge Higher on Friday as Investors Assess Nvidia Fallout
items.summary: S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures rose modestly on November 13 ahead of October PPI inflation data, as investors assessed impact of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. Markets expect 0.4% PPI increase versus prior month's 1.3%.

items.headline: Singtel Confirms Nvidia CEO Departure Has Not Hit AI Chip Deliveries
items.summary: Singtel stated that Jensen Huang's departure as Nvidia CEO has not impacted its AI chip deliveries, providing reassurance on supply chain continuity amid CEO transition.
